scenarios.name: lsa_secrets_psexec
scenarios.description: Real capture: PsExec -s runs reg save HKLM\security\policy\secrets as SYSTEM through its PSEXESVC service, writing the LSA secrets hive to a file in the user's Temp folder.
scenarios.alert: Alert on WORKSTATION5: process PsExec.exe. Review this process and its related activity.
scenarios.label_note: T1569.002 and T1543.003 accepted: PsExec installs and starts the PSEXESVC service to run the command.
